items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence: Applying `argmax` there naturally returns the position inside each padded/cumulative window, not the original absolute position along `time`.
items.rationale: Identifies root cause: argmax on padded constructed windows returns window-local index, in rolling.py reduce path. No fix described beyond expected test.
